reading.body:
Cindy Hyde-Smith's recorded AI activity is one cosponsorship, a run of votes on a single bill, and two Amazon PAC contributions of $2,500 each.

The votes cluster on S. 2296. She voted Yea on cloture, on the motion to proceed, on a motion to table an amendment, and on final passage, and she split across the ten amendments voted on the same day, taking Yea on three and Nay on six. The pattern is a senator who supported the bill's movement through the chamber while voting against most amendments offered to it. The one substantive AI measure is S. 4154, the Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026, which she cosponsored in March 2026.

The two Amazon PAC contributions, March 2025 and June 2026, are the only money in the record. They are small, identical, and from a single donor, so they establish a relationship with one AI-adjacent company's committee and nothing broader. Nothing here shows what S. 2296 contained, whether any amendment touched AI, or whether the contributions and the votes are related. The record covers federal legislative and campaign finance filings only. It says nothing about state-level action, committee work without a recorded vote, or the data center and power siting decisions that determine where AI compute actually gets built in Mississippi.
